ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ]; then exit 1; fi; if ! git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; changed_files=$(git diff --name-only $VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA $VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA); outside_denylist=$(echo "$changed_files" | grep -v -e '^apps/api/' -e '^openspec/' -e '\.md$'); [ -z "$outside_denylist" ]
